description:
Goal
Close the parallel-build phase by proving the new TransportPlan is complete enough for fz-hwn.19 to cut consumers over and delete the trash-prefixed model.

Required proof
The old compiler path still produces behavior, but tests and telemetry prove the independent TransportPlan answers the transport questions fz-hwn.19 needs: positions, shapes, lane facts, callable facts, BoundaryId contracts, seam-specific codegen facts, producer/resume shape identity, direct callable transport, first-class publication, and ignored-value Nothing nodes.

Old-code inventory
Produce an rg-backed removal inventory for fz-hwn.19: every remaining Trash* type/helper, recursive value mirror, shape translation helper, boundary recovery path, and codegen-local repr derivation. The inventory must classify each item by the new fact it should read during cutover.

Docs
Update outline/proposal/.agent docs touched by this model so they state: parallel construction is over; fz-hwn.19 consumes the independent flow graph and deletes old consumers. Remove any doc language that says the spine is introduced during the ripout epic.

Checks
All fz-hwn.20 targeted tests pass. cargo check --all-targets. Telemetry for the worked example and at least one fixture emits the expected transport-flow counts. bw tickets for fz-hwn.19 point at this handoff rather than asking future agents to rediscover the model.
title: Transport flow graph: prove independent authority and hand off to ripout
